# different rates (uncached input 1x, cache write 1.25x or 2x depending on TTL,

# not adjudicate it. These are the components that aggregate was built from,
# transcribed from the build-cost record keyed to the four Claude Code sessions
# that compiled the corpus on 2026-05-06.

# wikikb/experiments/run_ingest.py (lines 65-68), which emits only the sum.
# Verify with: python experiments/reconstruct_h3a.py

# totals.tokens_in of 898,594,660 exactly, to the token.
# Per-session cache_write / cache_read / output are recorded to the precision
# the build-cost record carries (0.01M); the uncached_in column and the class
# totals are exact. Session rows therefore reconcile to the totals row within
# rounding, and it is the totals row that reconciles exactly to the artifact.
